title: Alex Modern Blocks
description: Adds new vanilla style blocks missing from the game!
body:
In Vanilla Minecraft, some blocks are missing from existance (for example stone and smooth stone walls) and this mod ads all those missing blocks such as brand new vanilla-style diorite bricks! 

Currently under development so even if the current version is missing most of the blocks from the roadmap (see gallery) they will eventually be added!
